CustomField.description:
The value of this field should align to the Tanium Permitted Countries Policy document which is owned and maintained by the Legal team.
https://tanium.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/EmpHub-Policy%20Central/Shared%20Documents/Protecting%20Tanium%20Information%20%26%20IP/Permitted%20Countries%20Policy.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=cLJVjp
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tanium Direct Sales are permitted. For purposes of this category, the Tanium customer’s country designation is based on the country where the customer’s headquarters is located. However, even if a direct sale is permitted, this does not mean that the Tanium Server and Module Server can be installed in any country where a customer does business
CustomField.label: Tanium Direct Sales Permitted
